source.collection: Hemeroteca Digital BN, Correio da Manhã, coleção 089842

method.visual_exam: Each page rendered at 175 dpi and inspected in six overlapping crops (2 columns x 3 rows); headlines, body text, captions and advertising included; OCR is auxiliary only.

readings.subjects: Brasília/Fatos e Personagens: Biblioteca do Trabalhador and atomic-energy meeting; Rio education council; newborn mix-up at maternity hospital; Brigitte Bardot rumor; commercial advertisements.
Brazil-France diplomatic relations; Congresso and party politics; historical article on Anchieta and the foundation of São Paulo; political commentary; essay on free will.

readings.printed_folio_note: Numeral at top right is not completely unambiguous in the facsimile; do not infer a definitive printed folio.
readings.subjects: Editorial/opinion page on nationalization of private oil refineries and Capuava. Reprinted commentary cites Jornal do Brasil, Última Hora, O Globo, Diário de São Paulo and Folha de São Paulo from 8–11 November, all concerning petroleum, not the Conde occurrence.
unrelated_clock_labels: 8–11 November 1963 = newspaper publication dates for reprinted petroleum opinion, not local event times
